root_cause.text: The xfrm_policy_bysel_ctx() function released the xfrm_policy_lock before calling xfrm_policy_inexact_prune_bin(), creating a race window where another CPU could free the bin structure via xfrm_hash_rebuild() before the use-after-free access occurred.
root_cause.evidence: The patch demonstrates the race condition explicitly in the commit message: after spin_unlock_bh(xfrm_policy_lock) on CPU0, there is a "wide window, lock not held" where CPU1 can execute xfrm_hash_rebuild() and call kfree_rcu(bin), then CPU0 subsequently calls xfrm_policy_inexact_prune_bin(bin) resulting in a use-after-free. The fix moves the __xfrm_policy_inexact_prune_bin(bin, false) call to occur before spin_unlock_bh(), ensuring the bin is pruned while still holding the lock that protects it from concurrent freeing.
